label: 06 / FAQ
title: Questions? We got you.

items.q: Do I need a membership to play?
items.a: No. VEYA is 100% pay-and-play. Book courts or join matches on Playtomic with no subscription fees.

items.q: Can we play with 2 players or must it be 4?
items.a: Both! Padel is standard 4 players (doubles), but 2 players (singles / cross-court drills) is very popular. Same court booking applies.

items.q: How does the coaching assessment work?
items.a: Submit a 2-minute screening form above. Our head coach reviews your sporting background and confirms your class tier within 24 hours.

items.q: How does Playtomic split payment work?
items.a: The organizer reserves the court. Each friend is invited via the app and pays their share directly before the match.
Flat-soled tennis, padel, or gym sneakers with non-marking rubber soles. Running shoes with thick heels are discouraged.
